prometheus-29190.yml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s
rule_files:
- ~/.config/ecosystem-observability/ecosystem-prometheus-rules.yml
scrape_configs:
- job_name: collector-native
  honor_labels: true
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - 127.0.0.1:28889
- job_name: collector-health
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - 127.0.0.1:28888
- job_name: qdrant
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - 127.0.0.1:26333
- job_name: vllm
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - 127.0.0.1:18231
- job_name: prometheus
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - 127.0.0.1:29190
- job_name: loki
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - 127.0.0.1:13100
- job_name: alertmanager
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - 127.0.0.1:19093
- job_name: adaptive-paper
  file_sd_configs:
  - files:
    - ~/.config/ecosystem-observability/adaptive-paper-targets.json
    refresh_interval: 30s
- job_name: acceptance-fixture
  scrape_interval: 5s
  scrape_timeout: 2s
  file_sd_configs:
  - files:
    - ~/.config/ecosystem-observability/acceptance-targets.json
    refresh_interval: 5s
